cc:Work.dc:title: f02_local_lowering
cc:Work.dc:description: Three panels show the crossing construction, a rejected proposal and the successor guard. At positions 253 to 256, SIMPLE makes q3 and q1 decoder calls while LOCAL makes a q4 call with 3+1 attention views and rejoins before output projection and FFN. SIMPLE preserves its first call's owned logit row z1 by synchronization and copying. Rejection leaves KV positions 0 to 254 and a correction pending at 255. LOCAL continues from its own commit at positions 255 to 258, rebuilds 1+3 views after the full extent vector changes, and leaves the bonus selected from z3 pending at 259. Box spans encode query membership, not time or memory size; the two policy arms are alternatives.
